article.title: Binance Suffers Security Breach Affecting $6.3 Billion in Assets, Nearly $3 Billion Frozen
article.summary: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3 billion worth of assets. The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange said nearly $3 billion of those assets have been frozen on-chain so far. article.title: Hackers Steal 2.6 Million Records From Sony’s Japanese ISP So-net
